info.title: Likerts development API
info.description: API contract with PostgreSQL persistence, tenant RLS and optional explicit development-only memory mode. Management accepts scoped service credentials or provider-neutral OIDC JWTs and keeps workspace membership and grants authoritative in Likerts; hosted Clerk and payment evidence remain open. JSON request bodies have a 65536-byte limit. All content bounds count Unicode scalar values; objects reject unknown properties unless documented otherwise.

get.summary: Retrieve one stable snapshot page of workspace responses, optionally filtered by collection and acceptance time. Continue with nextCursor.
get.description: Responses are ordered by an immutable acceptance sequence. The first page fixes a snapshot boundary; responses accepted after that boundary are excluded from every continuation. nextCursor binds the original limit and filters. Supplying a different filter or limit with a cursor returns 400. acceptedFrom is inclusive and acceptedTo is exclusive.

managementBearer.description: OIDC JWT or tenant-bound service credential. Human OAuth requests select a workspace with X-Likerts-Workspace; Likerts rechecks the token scope, durable grant and current membership. Static all-access tokens are development-only.

collectionBearer.description: Collection token returned by collections_create. Only schema access and submission for that collection. Management credentials do not substitute.

monitorBearer.description: Separate LIKERTS_MONITOR_TOKEN; not a management or collection credential.

browserSessionBearer.description: First-party browser session only. Exact issuer, audience, expiry, subject and authorized-party Origin are verified; it is not an OAuth capability token.

VisibilityCondition.description: One bounded predicate. answered/not_answered forbid value; other operators require it. equals/not_equals apply to scalar answers; includes/not_includes apply to multiple-choice selections. The backend validates reference existence, source compatibility, choice/range membership and an acyclic dependency graph. Comparison operators are false when the effective source answer is absent; answered trims strings.

multiple_choiceQuestion.description: Selection bounds must satisfy effective minimum <= maximum <= option count. Effective minimum is max(minSelections or 0, required ? 1 : 0). Default maximum is option count. Optional answers may be omitted, but a supplied array must respect the bounds. Backend enforces these related-field constraints.

labels.description: Keys must be canonical integer strings within min/max; the backend enforces range membership.

Question.description: Question IDs must be unique within a survey; option IDs unique within each question; min must not exceed max. Backend validates these cross-field constraints. Expanded fields are permitted only on their respective types. preset, labels, minSelections or maxSelections require schemaVersion 2. visibleWhen, Other/exclusive choices or presentation require schemaVersion 3. Hidden answers are discarded before validation and persistence; hidden required questions are not required. ranking, matrix or constant_sum requires schemaVersion 5.

questions.label: How likely are you to recommend us?

idempotencyKey.description: Required by survey creation; omitted from draft update payloads.

questions.label: How likely are you to recommend us?

SdkCapabilities.description: Customer-declared installed SDK groups. Every group must include the published/bound survey schema version. This is a compatibility guard, not attestation.

expiresAt.description: Optional future expiry, at most 90 days from creation.

token.description: Opaque limited collection bearer credential; never parse its format. Returned on creation; cannot manage surveys or read responses.

items.description: Exact HTTPS origin; loopback HTTP is allowed for development.

schemaVersion.description: 1 for legacy six-type surveys; 2 for expanded presets, labels or selection bounds; 3 for conditional visibility, Other/exclusive choices or presentation controls; 4 for pages and bounded forward branching. 5 for ranking, matrix and constant-sum questions.

answers.description: Question-ID keyed answers. Legacy and schema-v3 choice answers retain their documented wire types. Ranking is a complete option-ID permutation; matrix is a row-ID map to a column ID or nonempty column-ID array; constant_sum is an exact item-ID map to nonnegative integers totaling the configured total. The backend validates dynamic membership, sums, requiredness, routes and visibility.

metadata.description: Untrusted caller metadata; compact serialized JSON must be at most 4096 bytes.

answers.description: Question-ID keyed answers. Strings for text/date/single_choice; unique option-ID string arrays for multiple_choice; numbers for number; integers for scale. Required questions must be answered, unknown IDs rejected, bounds/options/date validity checked against published schema. Optional answers are omitted, not null.

metadata.description: Untrusted caller metadata; compact serialized JSON must be at most 4096 bytes.

nextCursor.description: Opaque continuation cursor; null when the snapshot is exhausted.

ExportInput.description: Optional collection and acceptance-time filters use the same inclusive acceptedFrom and exclusive acceptedTo semantics as response retrieval.

unpaidExposureCents.description: Only unsettled pre-credit legacy usage; promotional and prepaid-funded responses create no unpaid exposure.

acceptingPaidResponses.description: Legacy field name: whether a new valid response can currently be funded from promotional or paid credits.

Usage.description: Gross immutable one-cent accepted-response accounting, response-credit balances and legacy unpaid exposure. Gross chargedCents is not a cash charge: promotional/prepaid-funded responses are excluded from postpaid settlement. Monthly spend limits apply to paid-credit consumption; promotional credits are consumed first. Zero credits closes new acceptance; prior valid retries consume nothing.

matrixQuestion.description: rows × columns is limited to 200; semantic validation enforces unique IDs and plain columns without Other/exclusive.

eventTypes.description: Immutable event subscriptions. Defaults to response.accepted. Credit thresholds require usage:read as well as webhooks:write when creating or enabling the endpoint.
Immutable event subscriptions. Defaults to response.accepted. Credit thresholds require usage:read as well as webhooks:write when creating or enabling the endpoint.

WebhookEndpointUpdate.description: Pause, enable or permanently revoke. URL and event subscriptions are immutable. Enabling a credit subscriber requires usage:read in addition to webhooks:write.

paidCreditDebt.description: Consumed credits whose processor funds were later refunded or disputed. Acceptance remains paused until this reaches zero.

CreditBalance.description: Append-only response-credit balances and consumed sources. One credit funds one accepted response; promotional credits are consumed before paid credits. Recorded purchases require trusted operator/payment reconciliation, never customer minting.

paymentMode.description: Configured payment-provider mode, not confirmation that a purchase settled.

WebhookCreditThresholdEvent.description: Opt-in balance depletion notification. Each promotional or paid bucket has its own generation. A positive available-balance increase starts a new generation with the resulting balance as baseline. Consumption, refunds and negative adjustments can cross 80/90/100 percent depletion. A paid top-up never rearms promotional alerts. At most one event per bucket, generation and threshold; no past crossings are backfilled on subscription. Payload excludes balances and answers. Query usage_get for current credits; an alert may precede a later top-up. Deduplicate by event id and verify the normal webhook signature.
